action: Place the probe onto the upper right quadrant (URQ). Verify the system is set to 'Abdominal mode'.
interpretation: Prepare the abdominal preset for right-sided scanning.

action: Instruct patient: 'Breathe in'. Scan through the acoustic window until the rib shadow passes.
interpretation: Identify the rib artifact ('that was our rib') to locate the window.

action: Locate the liver. Instruct patient: 'Hold that please' (breath hold).
Scan the liver parenchyma. Contour the probe down.
interpretation: Note the 'homogenous structure' of the liver and visualize the 'portal system'.

action: Adjust the image position ('Move the C'). Center the image.
interpretation: Optimize the view, noting a 'little refraction from the ribs'.

action: Identify the kidney area. Adjust the focal zone ('focus in on there').
interpretation: Target the 'central fat of the kidney'.

action: Rotate the probe to align with the organ axis.
Instruct patient: 'Okay, you can breathe, sir.' Move the probe to 'follow the kidney' as the patient exhales.
interpretation: Maintain visualization of the kidney during respiratory movement.

action: Instruct patient: 'And again, breathe in'. Apply probe pressure ('Push down').
interpretation: Displace bowel gas and improve contact.
Confirm visualization of the 'patient's right kidney'.

action: Adjust the view ('Lower it a bit there'). obtain a mid-sectional view.
interpretation: Assess internal architecture: confirm 'renal fat' and the 'sinus in the central portion' seem normal.

action: Instruct patient: 'Take a deep breath'. Scan specifically for tissue boundaries.

interpretation: Magnify the view of the kidney.

action: Freeze the image. Use the caliper tool to 'measure' using 'multi-distance'.

interpretation: Plan to repeat the protocol on the left side.

action: Sweep ('perusing') the kidney from 'lower pole to upper pole'.
interpretation: Confirm negative findings: 'I don't see any evidence of any calcifications, stones, or tumors'.
